q: আমি তাকে দিয়ে চিঠিটি লিখালাম।
o: I wrote the letter by him.
I had written the letter by him.
I had the letter written by him
I got the letter being written by him
e: কাউকে দিয়ে কাজ করানো বোঝাতে have + object + past participle গঠন ব্যবহার হয়, তাই I had the letter written by him সঠিক। এটি causative গঠন, যেখানে কর্তা নিজে কাজটি করেননি। Got the letter being written ভুল, কারণ get + object-এর পরে past participle বসে, being written নয়। প্রথম দুটি অপশনে কর্তা নিজেই লিখেছে বোঝায়, আর by him যোগ হয়ে অর্থ বিকৃত হয়েছে।

q: Choose the correct passive form: 'They are building a bridge.'
o: A bridge is being built by them.
A bridge is built by them.
A bridge was being built by them.
A bridge has been built by them.
e:
Active বাক্যটি Present Continuous Tense-এ আছে। এই Tense-এর Passive গঠন: Object + is/am/are + being + V3 + by + Subject। তাই A bridge is being built by them। Present Simple বা Present Perfect-এর রূপ বসালে Tense বদলে যায়।
মনে রাখুন:
Past Continuous Passive: was/were + being + V3।
উদাহরণ: The boys were being taught by him।
